It's not one state versus others – it's the United States. I want you to know: I see you, I hear you, and I promise we have your back." The tweet was posted one day prior to the screenshot being taken. The image accompanying the tweet shows a group of people standing outdoors under a wooden structure that appears to be part of a dock or marina.
